header: Abbreviations that a circular DEFINES ITSELF ("financial assistance (FA)"), shared by the engine (server) and the briefing (screen). I accept a definition only if the initials of the words before the bracket spell the abbreviation, so a loose phrase ("RFID Card Biometric (RFID)") is never taken for an expansion.

symbols.name: expansionFromPhrase
symbols.sig: export function expansionFromPhrase(abbr: string, phrase: string): string | null
doc: "Contactless Face Recognition System (CFRS)": I accept the words before the bracket as the expansion only if the INITIALS of the last words spell the abbreviation, and then I use only those words. Returns null when they do not.

symbols.name: definedAbbreviations
symbols.sig: export function definedAbbreviations(text: string): Record<string, string>
doc: Returns every "Full Phrase (ABBR)" of the text whose initials spell the abbreviation: { FA: "Financial Assistance" }. The first definition of an abbreviation stands.

symbols.name: usedDefinitions
symbols.sig: export function usedDefinitions(defined: Record<string, string>, shown: string): Record<string, string>
doc: Returns the definitions (from definedAbbreviations) of the abbreviations a piece of text actually uses, as whole capital words.
